Two pages of a personal knowledge base about its owner's life. Each page describes one person.

PAGE A
Name: Sam
About: Sam is Alex's climbing partner from the bouldering gym.
Facts:
- Climbs with Alex twice a week
- Met Alex at the bouldering gym

PAGE B
Name: Sam Brennan
Also called: Sam B.
About: Sam Brennan is an analytics engineer on Alex's team at Northwind Labs.
Facts:
- Works with Alex on the data platform team
- Works at Northwind Labs
- Works at Nortwind Labs

What the owner's sources say:
- Alex goes bouldering twice a week with Sam, a climbing partner from the gym, and enjoys long-distance running.
- Sam Brennan, an analytics engineer, joined Alex's team in 2023.
- Alex is building Tidepool, an internal alerting service at Northwind Labs that flags data-quality anomalies in the nightly pipelines, together with Sam Brennan.

questions.name: same
questions.instructions: Are page A and page B about the same person?

choices.description: yes, one person: one name is another way of writing the other (a nickname, a misspelling, an abbreviation, a translation, a longer form)
no, two different persons that only look alike or are related
